reviews.comment: Spent 6 weeks on the social contract, every class ended with 'but what even IS society' and her leaving. Midterm said 'evaluate democracy.' No instructions. I got a 43. Commented 'where's your thesis?' — she had underlined it. Described the UN as 'basically vibes.' AVOID AT ALL COSTS.

This was by far the most difficult class I've ever taken, and Professor Onder lacked compassion for her students. She was extremely difficult to approach, rarely responded to my emails, and this is the first time I've ever failed a class in my entire life. She does not curve at all so I failed. The TAs did all of the work for her.

She is a good person, but not a very good instructor. I was out with a family emergency and was expected to turn in a lab report, which I had missed lab. It was unfair. TAs were unresponsive through email, and mine only had office hours once a week. It was a frustrating class, not because of the difficulty but because of the lack of compassion.

This class is not too bad if you get a good TA. She makes the exams super easy but not really related to lectures. If you are confused on why you got points off on your labs, she is usually pretty understanding and might adjust your grade. Attend your labs, double check your reports with your TA, and you'll be fine.
Easy A if you put in the work! Would take again.
reviews.ratingTags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: If grading isn't done properly, it is probably due to the TA but if you ask Dr.Onder to change the grade, she does. Responds to emails and offers extra credit. The class did have a lot of work to do during the week but if you take like 3 hours to do it during one sitting, it should be fine. She is really nice and provides a lot of opportunities.
reviews.ratingTags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Professor Onder was always understanding and caring when it came to helping you with assignments. The lab reports are worth 40% of your grade but honestly, there is so many resources that can help you including TA's , Chat GPT and in r code : help("function_name"). Overall the class was hard at times but she gives extra credit for the free.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Clear grading criteria--So many papers

reviews.comment: I really don't know why there are so many low grades. I'm not going to lie, the class is hard, but that doesn't reflect on her as a professor. She is very understanding and gave me many extensions when I thought I couldn't complete the material on time. Disconnect the teacher from the material!! Learning R Script will always be hard!! Go to class
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: She's nice, and the class isn't hard, just very unorganized. Her lectures are not related to the assignments. You're 100% dependent on your TA, who might also be learning how to use the application as they go. A fourth of your grade is a project that isn't explained until the last week. The exams are easy, but they're only 30% of your grade.

This is a required class, but if you have the choice not to take her, don't. She's not the worst teacher ever, but her class is incredibly dull. The lecture has nothing to do with the lab reports, and honestly, don't waste your time taking notes. The most important part of this class is the labs, and if you don't get a good TA, good luck!

This was a required class and it was one of the most confusing class I've ever taken. The grading system she uses is complicated and frustrating. The lectures were not engaging and extremely boring. The lab sessions are a literal gamble with your TA. The midterm was both timed and overly complicated. Overall, my worst class experience so far.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: She has terrible grading principles. Take record of everything she does during testing. She will try to take as much time from you as possible during the middle as she wants you to sign honor code during 2nd half of test.
She is very lecture heavy. Students pay her to do a service (educate them properly) and doesn't do the service well. Lots of homework and the only help is the TA, don't expect [blank] from her.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: I have to cut her some slack bc my section was her first time teaching 209, but make no mistake, ChatGPT will be your professor for this class, not her. You will work much closer with your TA's on anything that affects your grade. She is professional, kind, and a normal person, but I would not choose her to be my professor again.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: The lectures were not engaging and did not aid me in the actual work assigned in the class. With a good TA it would be manageable as the TA's informed us more on test and project information than she did.  She is teaching such an important class for political science majors, and I do not think she prepares you well for upper-level POLS classes.
Do not take her. I did not learn anything, and had to teach myself. My TA was better at teaching the class than she was.

Anyone giving her a bad rating is probably someone who hasn't had to put effort into a class yet (a freshman). She is a great professor. I think I could have gotten an A with more effort and a better TA. Any POLS 209 class is complete luck when it comes to the professor and Onder is fine. You will be fine and learn if you show up and put in effort.

Lectures are boring and unhelpful, she literally put me to sleep, and I learned nothing. The class structure is chaotic, with assignments that felt all over the place. We had a final project and a final exam due in the same week. I passed because of my TA, not her teaching. Avoid her if you can.
